pr_title: Updates all our icons to use Segoe Fluent
pr_body:
* use `FontFamily="{ThemeResource SymbolThemeFontFamily}"` where possible, in XAML
* use `FontFamily{ L"Segoe Fluent Icons, Segoe MDL2 Assets" }` in codebehind

Basically just a simple string replace.

* [x] This was a bullet point in #11353
* [x] Confirmed manually on my win10 PC
* see also #12438

Actually, this is the last bullet in #11353, so I'm gonna say closes #11353. 

Screenshots below.

issue_context.title: Miscellaneous Settings UI nits
issue_context.body:
_discovered in the 1.12 bug bash on 9/28, but these aren't 1.12 blocking issues_

* [x] Navigation View Sidebar] the names of the new VS names don't fit (nor do they get a tooltip) 
  -  Proposal: add tooltips? Don't just crop? 
  - Fixed in #12448
* [x] [Actions page] there's an unnamed action (appears as `Microsoft.Terminal.Settings.Editor.KeyBinding`). After adding it, when clicking "Add new" again or saving, it disappears. Saving it also doesn't appear in the JSON. 
* [x] [Appearance tab of a profile] Background image path does not appear in the text box
* [x] [Appearance tab of a profile] "Reset to inherited value" button for the padding slider needs to be hit twice to make the button go away
* [x] ![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/18356694/135151407-431423ed-4a61-4e19-b00c-45cb2691ec45.png) Needs padding under it, 
  * [x] ... should be lowercase a on appearance, 
  * [x] ... should probably have "Add" after the plus button 
  * [x] ... and scoot the button to the left (same distance that the rename button has with the color scheme dropdown)
  * fixed in #12451
* [x] ![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/18356694/135151440-ddb6b3c4-a9e8-42c3-8685-05554e1acc15.png) Button should have "Delete" after the icon
* [x]  "Intense Text Style" Also lowercase t and s on text style
* [ ] The settings icon in the tab should be updated to the new gear icon (used in the Open JSON file nav item) 
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/48369326/153055317-da8ec0b7-b476-4f36-af89-09d614a947af.png)
  - Mike note: I'm on this. There's a lot of places we use the wrong font
  - in #12469

<hr>

The following were noted after #12241 merged
* [x] The commandline box could be wider. It takes up a fairly low percent of the expander, esp. when the terminal is maximized 
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/18356694/151963472-72673386-979a-44ab-bfd7-81e14e2fb0a7.png)
  - Fixed in #12326
* [x] #12328
* [x] #12335
* [x] #12350
* [ ] #12359
* [ ] more...
comments: Imo, the hamburger menu in the settings should be removed, it's really not doing any good for UX and just takes space.

Oh accidently used my work account, so, I would do the same thing that it does currently where it hides the label when the window gets too small but otherwise always display them. 

If it is a goal for users be able to see the label names even if the window is super small, maybe make the left side resizable?

One thing that might look better would be making the settings backdrop a single color. From what I've seen, NavigationView isn't really designed to look right with TabView above it, which results in these sort of cut-off corners, rather than the NavigationView blending in the the window's titlebar.

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/42101043/152550003-cfa825f0-5f7a-406a-8c24-972a18c13412.png)

:tada:This issue was addressed in #12469, which has now been successfully released as `Windows Terminal Preview v1.13.1073`.:tada:
